tagline: Stochastic computing and neuromorphic hardware co-design toolkit
summary: SC-NeuroCore is a research-to-hardware software stack for designing spiking and stochastic neural systems, validating their numerical behaviour, and moving selected models toward FPGA, ASIC, and embedded neuromorphic deployment. It combines a Python public API, an optional Rust acceleration engine, SystemVerilog generation paths, benchmark evidence, and polyglot research mirrors for selected kernels.
highlights: Stochastic bitstream encoders, probabilistic arithmetic, Sobol and LFSR sources, and bounded-error reasoning are first-class components.
Selected workflows generate Verilog and SystemVerilog artefacts, synthesis reports, and hardware-readiness evidence.
Public benchmark claims are tied to committed benchmark or hardware-report artefacts.
Python-first public surfaces are separated from opt-in polyglot and source-checkout research paths.
